content: 2025 NDFL 5-step progressive scale confirmed across multiple sources (nalog-nalog.ru, garant.ru, astral.ru): up to 2.4M RUB/yr = 13%, 2.4M-5M = 15%, 5M-10M = 18%, 10M-23.7116M = 20%, above 23.7116M = 22%. True marginal-bracket system - each rate applies only to the income slice within that bracket, calculated cumulatively (нарастающим итогом) from Jan 1 of the calendar year, not retroactively to earlier payments.
